sources.evidence: Standalone Gemini 4 Neon/Carbon/Argon/Hydrogen, Neon 512K window, Neon CLI gemini-4-neon-xhigh, supported thinking levels, Claude 5.5 models.

Literal membership confirmed for Carbon/Argon low-medium-high, Hydrogen low-medium-high-xhigh, Gemini 3.8 Flash low-medium-high, and both Claude 5.5 low-medium-high-max. Installed binary predates Neon; Neon follows the documented CLI family and effort suffix.
Proxy 2.7.7 supports dynamic fetchAvailableModels metadata; bare Claude 5.5 aliases still resolve to 4.6, so crouter normalizes to explicit 5.5 tier IDs before forwarding.

accountCatalogPolicy.source: Existing loopback proxy /v1/models only; precise returned model IDs and thinking variants, never static completion.
accountCatalogPolicy.unavailableBehavior: 401, 503, empty directory or transport failure yields no selectable models, with unavailable/unknown status. all --check does not query the network.

verification.realLocalProxyCatalog: HTTP 503 No accounts available; both providers correctly expose zero candidates

argonAvailabilityCorrection.reason: User clarified the account is Google AI Ultra and Argon remains available. The primary agent then observed Gemini 4 Argon Medium in the native Antigravity app model selector.
argonAvailabilityCorrection.decision: Removed the local Argon hard block and restored known low/medium/high IDs and bare-to-medium alias. Actual selectable variants still require the live proxy account directory; no static fallback is permitted.
argonAvailabilityCorrection.verificationLevel: Native app availability was observed by the primary agent; proxy account authentication/inference remains unverified.
argonAvailabilityCorrection.consumerRegression: A real loopback proxy response offering Argon is preserved by models, inventory, and unified gateway consumers. Generic blocking uses a synthetic fixture ID.
